facts.fact: Kiran 差点提到 Amrita 的前任 Suraj，Amrita 立刻打断说好不再提这个名字。
Amrita 向 Kiran 形容 Jamie 的眼睛是灰蓝两色、会随情绪变色。
facts.anchor: They’re sort of grey and blue at the same time and seem to change colour with his mood.

facts.fact: 她在 sangeet 上跳舞，身体记得从小的舞步与手腕手指动作。
facts.anchor: the steps, isolations, shoulder pops and wrist and finger flicks that she’d known since childhood

facts.fact: Jamie 到酒店才发现订房订成了下个周末，当周末已满。
facts.anchor: Your room is actually booked for next weekend.

facts.fact: Amrita 穿着春空色、绣粉花的礼服到酒店大堂接他。
facts.anchor: She was dressed in an outfit the colour of the perfect spring sky

facts.fact: Amrita 说自己是成年人，可以自己决定让他同住一间房。
facts.anchor: I’m an adult. I’m allowed to make my own decisions

facts.fact: 她收拾行李时露出一件白色丝绸衣物，Jamie 觉得莫名眼熟却想不起来。
facts.anchor: And an oddly familiar garment of white silk

facts.fact: Jamie 用椅垫在床中间垒了一道「屏障」，自己睡在被子上面。
清晨她意识到，她不只是喜欢他眼睛变色，她想成为那个让颜色变化的人。
facts.anchor: it was that she wanted to be the one they changed for
